command: set -e; src=/code/website/static/public/js; dst=/wiki_static; bundle=$(ls "$src"/wiki-edit-page.*.js 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); if [ -z "$bundle" ]; then echo "wiki_assets: no wiki-edit-page.*.js under $src" >&2; exit 1; fi; if [ ! -w "$dst" ]; then echo "wiki_assets: $dst is not writable by $(id -u)" >&2; exit 1; fi; cp -R "$src"/. "$dst"/; if [ -f /code/webpack-assets.json ]; then cp /code/webpack-assets.json "$dst"/webpack-assets.json; fi; cp "$dst/$(basename "$bundle")" "$dst"/wiki-edit-page.js; for f in "$dst"/*; do n=$(basename "$f"); if [ ! -e "$src/$n" ] && [ "$n" != wiki-edit-page.js ] && [ "$n" != webpack-assets.json ]; then rm -rf "$f"; fi; done; test -s "$dst"/wiki-edit-page.js; ls -la "$dst"
note: One-shot (ADR-06): runs the wiki-frontend bundle-builder image grdm-dev/wiki-frontend:<osf_sha12>-<wiki_sha12> (osf.io tree + wiki-frontend files, built with the wiki-frontend Dockerfile, which only runs `yarn run webpack-prod`), requires a wiki-edit-page.<chunkhash>.js under /code/website/static/public/js/ (the webpack output.path; also vendor.<hash>.js, source maps) and copies it with `cp -R` (no ownership preservation) into the named volume wiki_static mounted at /wiki_static, adds /code/webpack-assets.json and the unhashed alias wiki-edit-page.js, then prunes files that are no longer in the source (copy first, prune after: a running consumer never sees an empty directory), and exits. The volume is chowned to 1000:1000 beforehand by wiki_static_init (a fresh bind volume under runtime/volumes/ is owned by the host user). web/api/admin/worker mount wiki_static read-only at /code/website/static/public/js/wiki/ (a subpath: the osf.io image's own public/js keeps its ~40 bundles and its webpack-assets.json) and depend on this service with condition service_completed_successfully. The command is written for the container shell; compose render escapes `$` as `$$` so Compose does not interpolate it (PR #30 review r1). The osf.io page must reference /static/public/js/wiki/wiki-edit-page.js (RDM-osf.io-dev2027 edit.mako wiring, verified in real install run 5).
